Niche.Offer: Coldstart is a done-for-you lead engine: every morning it finds B2B companies showing a buying signal right now, qualifies them, and writes the first outreach email. You approve and it sends.
Disqualifiers: The company itself sells lead generation, sales-outreach, prospecting, appointment-setting, or cold-email software/services (a direct competitor)
An anonymous forum/comment author venting or sharing an opinion, not a named decision-maker at an identifiable company
A job seeker or candidate looking for a role
A large enterprise with an established outbound team unlikely to buy from a solo operator
